title: Envelope
description: The envelope of every v4 message: the usual one, with v4's `SchemaId`.

event_id.description: Events only: unique per event, for deduplication on redelivery.

last_event_seq.description:
Scenes only: the `seq` of the last event published before this scene,
so a consumer knows which events the scene already reflects.

observed_at.description:
Source time of what is claimed: without a new sample, that of the last
observed one.

profile.description: The configuration the engine ran with.

published_at_ms.description: Wall clock; set by publishing, never by the core.

schema.description: What the body is: a scene or an event.

seq.description: Contiguous from 1 per run and per schema; a gap is a lost message.

timing.description: Scenes only: how long the shell took with the sample.

oneOf.description: Nobody in the bed.
At least one visible occupant in the bed's stable count.
Nobody seen, with retained occupants.
The bed geometry does not apply to the image.

Before.description: What we believed, since when and for how long.

bed.description: `unknown` if the geometry does not apply, even with counts.

lasted_secs.description: Source seconds since `since`; `None` without `since` or across sessions.

mode.description: The machine's state those counts name.

rbh.description: Occupants of the room, of the bed and retained in it.

since.description: The sample of the previous transition; `None` on the first.

unexplained.description: Bodies in the bed that are not occupants (rule 6).

git.description: The commit it was built from.

oneOf.description: The zone count stabilized at a new value.
The shell reported a reception change.
The map learned something about the static world.

The bed had no history yet since the engine started: what is seen is
adopted, stabilized, without a step from the floor.

Cell.description:
The cell of a transition: `before:seen:after`, the natural key of the row.
Each part is written as decimal digits if all its counts are below
10; otherwise as a tuple (`(12,1,1)`).

Context.description: What happened during the span and decided the cell.

far.description: How many appeared far from the bed.

DerivedEvent.description: A change in what was published, with the occupancy at the end of the turn.

after.description: The occupancy at the end of the turn.

at.description: The sample in which it changed.

oneOf.description: The mode changed.
The bed changed; it goes to `unknown` without a transition.

Event.description:
A message of `events.v4`. Within a turn they come out in order: `sensor`,
`transition`, `map`, `derived`.

oneOf.description: A layer-0 change, with its facts.
A change in what was published, by comparing turns.
A reception change.
What the map learned.

Fact.description: A fact within its transition, with the occupancy it leaves.

after.description: The occupancy this fact leaves, before the next one.

oneOf.description: Someone appeared on the floor: they entered the room.
Someone stopped being seen on the floor: they left the room.

Someone appeared in bed coming from the floor; with cause `baseline`,
they were found in bed at startup.
Someone was seen moving from the bed to the floor.
Someone stopped being seen in bed without leaving: they are retained.

last_seen.description: The last sample they were seen in.

oneOf.description: Someone retained in bed was seen again.

held_since.description: The sample since which they were retained.

Fv.description: The pair `[F, V]`: admitted bodies seen on the floor and in bed.

LayerRef.description: A layer of the profile, by name and revision.

version.description: Its revision; `0` while layers are not versioned.

LookKind.description: What was asked to be looked at.

oneOf.description: The main person detector.
The face detector.
The finer detector over the bed, when the subject is lost.
The subject's pose.
The depth at image points.
The depth of the empty bed, to learn it.

MapEvent.description: What the map learned: not an occupancy fact.

at.description: The sample it was learned in.

oneOf.description: The map learned the depth of the empty bed.

reference_m.description: The empty bed's depth, on the depth model's scale.

Mode.description: The mode of the layer-0 machine: the name of its state.

oneOf.description: Nobody in the room.
One occupant, off the bed.
One occupant in bed, seen in the stable count.
One occupant in bed, retained.
More than one occupant.

Occupancy.description: The occupancy: a single shape for all of v4 (before, after, each fact).

bed.description: `unknown` if the geometry does not apply, even with counts.

mode.description: The machine's state those counts name.

rbh.description: Occupants of the room, of the bed and retained in it.

unexplained.description: Bodies in the bed that are not occupants (rule 6).

Phase.description:
The phase of rule 6: until the first climb into bed, whatever appears in
it is adopted.

oneOf.description: The bed has no history yet: whoever is clearly seen in it is adopted.
Someone climbed into bed from the floor: the bed only rises from it.

Profile.description: The configuration the engine ran with, as the consumer needs to compare runs.

camera.description: The camera layer of the profile.

hash.description: Two runs with the same hash believed with the same policy and map.

resident.description: The resident layer of the profile; `None` while there is none.

senses.description:
What each configured sense looks with. `hash` already covers them; this
names them for whoever watches, as in v2. Empty if the shell does not
report them.

ProfileHash.description: Hash of the effective policy the engine ran with.

Rbh.description:
The triple `[R, B, H]`: occupants of the room, of the bed (seen and
retained) and retained. They are counts: `0 ≤ H ≤ B ≤ R`.

SampleRef.description:
Which sample and when, in source time. It is the domain's only clock
(rule 9).

sequence.description: The sample's number, increasing within the run.

session.description: The stream session: a reconnection starts a new one.

source_secs.description: The sample's presentation time, comparable only within its session.

SchemaId.description: Which schema a v4 message carries.

oneOf.description: One scene per sample.
Every event, in order.

Seen.description: What we saw: the count that held, the span and its context.

context.description: What happened meanwhile, which decided the cell.

fv.description: The bodies seen on the floor and in bed, as they held.

span.description: How long they held before counting.

SenseProfile.description: The model and thresholds of a sense.

backend_confidence.description: Below this score the backend does not return the candidate.

min_confidence.description: Below this score the policy does not admit the candidate.

model.description: The model file, without its path.

SensorEvent.description: A reception change, reported by the shell.

after.description: The occupancy, which a reception change does not touch.

at.description: The sample the shell reported it with.

oneOf.description: The reception changed.

SensorState.description: The reception state, as the shell reports it. It says nothing about the bed.

oneOf.description: Opening the stream.
Samples are arriving.
Connected, but no sample within the stall timeout.
The stream dropped; trying again.

SessionId.description: Source session. Source time is only comparable within one session.

Source.description: Identity of the publishing shell; the core does not build these values.

camera.description: The camera within the site (a subject token).

run_id.description: One per process start: a new run restarts every numbering.

site.description: The site the camera belongs to (a subject token).

SourceSecs.description: Seconds of source time (video PTS) within a session.

Span.description: The span that held: from which sample and for how many source seconds.

first.description: The first sample that saw the new count.

secs.description: Source seconds it held before counting.

Timing.description:
How long the shell took with a sample, in wall-clock milliseconds. It is
measured by the shell and never decides anything (rule 9).

processing_ms.description: The whole turn: decoding, every look and the projection.

wait_ms.description: From the sample's arrival to the start of its turn.

Transition.description:
A layer-0 change: what we believed, what we saw, what we believe and the
facts, in order.

after.description:
The occupancy we believe at the end of the turn. Its occupants
(`rbh`, `mode`, `bed`) are those of the last fact; `unexplained` is the
scene's and may differ, because a body that is nobody comes and goes
without a fact (rule 6). A transition with no facts still has it.

at.description: The sample in which the new count held.

before.description: What we believed, and since when.

cell.description: The row of the layer-0 table this change crossed.

facts.description: What happened to each person, in order.

phase.description: The phase it was decided with.
